none: PAS NLM-395D72: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Burwell
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), FEL TEMP REPARATIO issue of 348-350 with emperor facing with standard and phoenix on galley, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Youthful bust cuirassed and either laureate or diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]?PF? AVG. Reverse description: Emperor facing with standard and phoenix on galley, Victory steering. Reverse…
